plcPhotos.basis: Original family photographs with a separate model-specific terminal layer

visualVerification: SVG rendered with sharp; eight instruments and eight representative PLCs inspected; photo mesh seam overlap corrected and rendered again.
uiVerification: Real app events exercised with deterministic DOM adapter: probe dragging, cancel, live readings, terminal count, ENDA front-key lock, persistence.
limitations: Family images are not exact photos of all hardware variants
Some instrument fronts are adaptations recovered from the supplied previous work
ENDA educational controller behavior is not manufacturer firmware
DIN 43710 type L numerical curve is unavailable and selection is disabled
Electrical calculation is a simplified steady-state resistive model
PLC program simulation is intentionally unsupported
